title: Design System v1
description: The approved token set and component rules screens must conform to. Deliberately richer than any AI provider's native theme model: provider themes are produced by projecting this (lossily) at request time, never by importing theirs. Sections marked as not projectable are enforced studio-side only. See docs/02-architecture/decisions/ADR-0004-provider-theme-projection-is-lossy.md.

scale.description: Named type styles. Projectable: Stitch accepts a free-form typography map.

color.description: Semantic colour roles, plus the colour modes the design system defines. Roles and modes are separate objects because they are different kinds of value: every role is a hex colour, so `roles` can carry an `additionalProperties` contract that a TypeScript index signature expresses exactly. Nesting `modes` among the roles forced that signature to admit arrays too, which let a type-checked payload carry `danger: ["light"]` and be rejected at runtime (M00-R3-002).

roles.description: Only primary, secondary, tertiary and neutral have a Stitch theme slot; any other role is studio-enforced only and the projection reports it as dropped.

modes.description: Stitch carries a single colorMode, so declaring both modes means only the first projects. The second needs a separate provider design system.

radiusBase.description: Base corner radius. Stitch exposes a five-step enum (2/4/8/12/full px), so other values snap to the nearest step with a warning.

spacing.description: Named spacing units. Projectable: Stitch accepts a free-form spacing map.

elevation.description: NOT projectable. Stitch's theme model has no elevation or shadow tokens.

motion.description: NOT projectable. Stitch's theme model has no motion or easing tokens.

breakpoints.description: NOT projectable. Stitch targets a device enum, not author-defined breakpoints.

borders.description: NOT projectable. Stitch exposes roundness only.

components.description: NOT projectable. Stitch has no component-variant model; these rules are checked during review.

fontFamily.description: CSS family name. A family with no Stitch equivalent falls back to Inter in the provider preview, with a reported warning; the studio still enforces the real family.
